headline: Veedol Corporation announces the resignation of Vice President Manufacturing Ranesh Sinha
summary: Veedol Corporation Limited has announced that Mr. Ranesh Sinha, Vice President of Manufacturing (SMP), has resigned from his position effective November 24, 2026. The company officially informed the stock exchanges regarding this executive departure. For an Indian retail investor, routine senior management exits in micro-cap companies like Veedol generally have a negligible impact on overall stock performance or financials.
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with negligible impact on stock value.

headline: Murli Vasudevan, VP of Sales (After Market), resigns from Veedol Corporation
summary: Murli Vasudevan, Vice President of Sales (After Market) at Veedol Corporation Limited, has tendered his resignation. His departure is effective from the close of business on Thursday, December 24, 2026. The company officially informed the stock exchanges regarding this management change. Routine senior management departures have minimal impact on retail investors unless tied to broader operational shifts.
why_it_matters: Routine management exits rarely move stock prices.
